d:
Rajouri ke ek gaon mein das din ke andar 17 logon ki rahasyamayi maut ho jaati hai. Paani ke saare zariye band kar diye jaate hain, aur gaon wale ek anjaan Jal Pishach se khauf khaane lagte hain. Jab Dr. Aryan Gupta is maamle ki jaanch karne pahunchte hain, toh unhe milte hain kaale paani se bhare phephde, ek sunsaan kuaan aur ek aisi awaaz jo baar-baar poochhti hai, “Kya tum insaan ho?”
Aakhir us raat Imtiyaaz ke saath kya hua? Aur kya Dr. Aryan sach mein wahan se bachkar nikle the?
Dekhiye Sannata,
